name: showtime (local video studio for agents)
what: Motion graphics, trailers, voice-over, music, sound design, captions, footage edits and platform exports - made locally by LOKI's agents, no cloud and no keys.

doctor.what: Check the installation (what is ready, what is missing).

render.what: Render a showtime project to video (the agent builds the project with showtime's MCP tools).

job.what: the job folder name (showtime job init)

qa.what: Verify a finished video (frames, audio, captions, sizes).

notes: Needs Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ (or uv). setup downloads about 0.5-0.75 GB into ~/.showtime. LOKI's OpenCode agent gets showtime's MCP server (new_project, render, check, snap, qa, voice, music, sfx, mix, exports) once it is installed - the full director workflow.
